findings.title: G7 formal preflight accepted replacement theory family in the corrected denominator
findings.evidence: The pre-repair in-memory mutation preserved 23 families, four CF types per family, bijective paired-set lineage, public/label hashes, and complete plan structure while replacing an audited family; strict preflight returned allowed=true and errors=[].
findings.remediation: Freeze and enforce the exact audited 23-family corrected denominator, excluding TB-L1-010, and add an adversarial replacement-family regression test.

resolutions.evidence: The strict contract now compares the public family set with the frozen corrected 23-family set. The replacement-family test passes; focused G7 tests pass 55/55; the full suite passes 245/245; immutable preflight and an independent data-only scan report the exact family set with no missing or extra IDs.
resolutions.reason: Local formal-denominator identity defect fixed; provider, provenance, mathematical, statistical, and scientific-release gates remain external or blocked.
